judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus a 2x crop of the sign region; strict per-requirement pass/fail. Self-judged: the judging model is the artifact's own model.

requirements.text: Create a main structure for a wooden fruit stall, including a counter.
requirements.note: brown wooden facade with shelf boxes and a counter line above the crates

requirements.text: Add a red and white striped canopy over the stall, supported by two vertical wooden posts.
requirements.note: red/cream striped scalloped awning on two brown vertical posts

requirements.text: Display exactly four different, recognizable fruits.
requirements.note: six kinds shown: oranges, apples, green pears, grapes, bananas, yellow lemons/limes

requirements.text: First fruit: A pile of red apples in a wicker basket on the left side of the counter.
requirements.note: red apples on the left but in a plain wooden crate, no wicker weave

requirements.text: Second fruit: A bunch of yellow bananas placed next to the apples.
requirements.note: bananas hang at the far right of the stall, not next to the apples

requirements.text: Third fruit: A pile of oranges in another wicker basket on the right side of the counter.
requirements.note: oranges sit in the middle crate (plain wood); the right crate holds yellow fruit

requirements.text: Fourth fruit: A single, large slice of watermelon resting directly on the counter in the center.
requirements.note: no watermelon anywhere in the scene

requirements.text: Include a character representing the stall vendor, a smiling man with a mustache, positioned behind the counter and between the baskets.
requirements.note: no person anywhere in the scene

requirements.text: Add a small, hanging chalkboard sign from the canopy that reads 'Fresh Fruit'.
requirements.note: 'FRESH FRUIT' board present with correct text but mounted on the stall wall, no suspension from the canopy (crop confirms no strings)

requirements.text: Depict a cobblestone ground surface in front of the stall.
Include the silhouette of another market stall in the background to suggest a larger market setting.
requirements.note: plain sky background, no other stall
